positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Work in the Advanced Software Division
Assisted in development in Vipr(software-defined storage) applications 
Developed a Vipr simulator for testing purposes 
Designed a Vipr Application that retrieves physical objects and displays on a table. 
The application also has a search feature, which can be used to query particular information and will locate it for you and give you all the information about the object.
Used numerous languages (Python, HTML, Jquery, CSS) in order to accomplish tasks

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Developed and published Android application using Android Studios. 
The application is being used in the field today
Application is called Fvdrills, it is a mobile form of the fishing vessel drills
The app has various drills to complete.
Once a drill has been completed, it will save the data to the a log file and then the user has the option to email the logs if desired

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Team Leader
Wrote Python scripts used autonomously fly the drone. 
Used MATLab in order to interpret collected drone data.
Used SolidWorks to create and 3D print replacement legs for drone.
Assembled and repaired drone, when needed

positions.title: Mathematics/Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Tutored colleagues ranging from college algebra to advanced calculus

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Tutored and mentored students in Algebra 1&2, and geometry in order to help them meet graduation requirements.
